mission.CivilRes_Corp_Espionage1.details:
Details: the Civil Resistance has long been fighting against the anarcho-capitalist regime of the System. However, individual actions are not enough to win. It wants to build up its own assets and start production.

Rebel agents have found out that at %STATION_NAME% the engineers of the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% are creating new equipment. If we steal the prototype, CR will not have to start from scratch. We can help the cause of liberation of the working class by completing this task.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Espionage1.objecti: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: pick up the prototype of the new invention and return with it to Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Infiltration1.afte: %VICTIM_NAME% is forced to find another way to learn about the plans of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. I think that events around %STATION_NAME% are only gaining momentum.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Infiltration1.brie: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has turned %STATION_NAME% into a kind of fortress. Despite this, some of the attackers will still pass through the anti-space defenses. Find them and eliminate them. This will serve as a good lesson for anyone who believes that the working class has lost the will to resist.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Infiltration1.deta:
Details: Recently, %STATION_NAME% has been the main center of operations for the Civil Resistance. The rebels carried out several extremely successful operations against %VICTIM_NAME%. The CR agents learned that the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% were preparing an operation to extract information from %STATION_NAME%. The target will be the PCPU of the colnode commander.

If we want to help the rebels, we must eliminate all of the corporation's infiltration teams.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_RaiderCapture1.aft:
The capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% staged a real hysteria in the SBN on the topic of terrorism and violation of laws. They needed to think before they decided to break the backbone of the working people.

By the way, the colnodes delivered aboard Magnum the cargo due to us for participating in the liberation movement.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_RaiderCapture1.bri: %STATION_NAME% is at your complete disposal. The enemy is known: their own <color=#FFFEC1>Security Service</color> or <color=#FFFEC1>PMC</color>, hired by the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME%. They will leave this place as soon as several fighters are missing.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_RaiderCapture1.det:
Details: Corporations have switched to an open terrorist dictatorship. They use the chaos that has arisen in the Solar System to strengthen the power of financial capital.

Apparently, the capitalists of %VICTIM_NAME% are preparing for a punitive operation against the workers of their own %STATION_NAME%. The Civil Resistance sends active signals that they are ready to save people from further oppression and take power into their own hands. We can help, but not for the sake of the happiness of the working people: the CR will not remain in debt.

The task is simple: eliminate everyone who able to hold a weapon and evacuate before this place becomes another branch of hell. Colnodes will appear when we are no longer at %STATION_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Robbery1.after: The capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% will have to deal with the destruction we caused at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. The colnodes took the junk and gave us some equipment.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Robbery1.briefing: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: find and pick up valuable items on each floor of the station. Smash and destroy everything you want, but take the goods. After that, evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Robbery1.details:
For almost a hundred years now, the Civil Resistance has been waging a desperate struggle against corporations. Humanity is enslaved. The heroic efforts of the rebels, without support and without supplies, sometimes seem simply meaningless. By the way, about supplies.

We have at our disposal an information package, from which it follows that there are valuable items at %STATION_NAME%. This is what the CR is missing to intensify actions in this region of the Solar System. The capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% clearly have no use for them.

We can help the rebels if we organize a movable property operation.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Robbery1.objective: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Sabotage1.after: %STATION_NAME% has been excluded from %VICTIM_NAME% structure for some time. The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> thanks us for our solidarity and hopes for our eventual joining in their struggle. Valuable cargo from the rebels is already on Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Sabotage1.briefing:
The locations of the communication network nodes have been marked on your map. Do not be surprised that they are located some distance away — countermeasures were used. This means that the security of %STATION_NAME% has already been placed on alert. Nothing unusual: the local Security Service and possibly PMCs.

First, destroy the transmitters. The rest depends on the circumstances.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Sabotage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the communications equipment of the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Sabotage1.details:
Details: %VICTIM_NAME% has firmly integrated %STATION_NAME% into its financial structure. Thanks to this asset, it managed to gain a foothold in this part of the System. The Civil Resistance has been keeping this place under its radar for a long time. The rebels would like to turn %STATION_NAME% into their own base of operations.

There is one sure way to prepare the space station for invasion. If you deal a blow to the communication system of %STATION_NAME%, which ensures its work with the rest of the structural elements of the corporation, then the capitalists %VICTIM_NAME% will be forced to loosen their grip. The rebels will be grateful if we strike.
mission.CivilRes_Corp_Sabotage1.objectiv: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>find and destroy the transmitters</color>. A transmitter is a satellite dish aimed into space. Their locations are marked on your map.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Control1.after: Great job, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. The colnodes prepared and sent valuable cargo to Magnum as a reward.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Control1.briefi: We deciphered the sensor data and marked the location of the cargo on your map. Sabotage groups will infiltrate %STATION_NAME% as they overcome the anti-space defenses. Eliminate them all and <color=#FFFEC1>do not let the cargo be destroyed</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Control1.detail: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> and the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> hate each other as much as they hate corporations. A group of colnodes holding %STATION_NAME% asks us to help protect the resource warehouse. For some reason, the pirates are trying to destroy it, sparing no effort and time.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Control1.object: You need to <color=#FFFEC1>defend the warehouse</color> of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. It is a mountain of boxes. You yourself have seen them many times in the cargo hold of Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Defense1.after: The rebels retained control of %STATION_NAME%. Direct actions proved to be a losing strategy for the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color>. This means that the pirates will now turn to murder, espionage, and sabotage. That is, there will be work for us soon. In the meantime, a cargo from the rebels arrived on Magnum in gratitude for the protection.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Defense1.briefi: It is necessary to <color=#FFFEC1>take a defensive position</color> and hold out until the attackers give up trying to storm the station. Remember that boarding is common for pirates. It might not be easy. Collateral damage shouldn't worry us. We have one mission: to ensure that %STATION_NAME% remains in the hands of the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> when the dust settles and the smoke clears.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Defense1.detail:
Details: It seems that the Unchained Belt should only be a problem for corporations, but pirates are not averse to profiting from the Civil Resistance. %STATION_NAME% is now the target of so-called "direct actions" by pirates. Yes, we are talking about capture.

The CR sends announcements about rewards for participation in the defense of %STATION_NAME%. Simple task: we land at the place specified by the customer and kill the pirates until they retreat.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Elimination1.af: Another enemy of the working class has been killed. And so it will be with everyone who dares to violate the will of the working people! The colnodes delivered the promised reward to Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Elimination1.br: We were given the target's personal signature. The sensors clearly show the commander among the rest of the personnel at %STATION_NAME%. The pirates can put up good resistance, but they can also run away in all directions, depending on your luck. <color=#FFFEC1>If you eliminate the target, come back</color>. Try not to get too distracted exploring %STATION_NAME%, it's not our priority.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Elimination1.de: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Find and eliminate the commander of the pirate crew.

Details: Capitalist anarchy reigns in the Solar System, controlled by NCE. However, groups that are not part of the ancap system live in real hell.

Now %STATION_NAME% is in the hands of pirates. Their commander is known for their cruelty not only towards corporations, but also towards the working people. The Civil Resistance asks for our help in carrying out a punitive action against this beast.

The elimination of an experienced pirate commander will be a message to the Unchained Belt that It's better not to get involved with the rebels.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Elimination1.ob: <color=#FFFEC1>Target</color>: commander of the pirate crew. He will shoot back, so be prepared.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Escort1.after: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> is extremely grateful for saving the life of an experienced commander. Colnode, who commanded the loading of the reward onto Magnum, scared me even more than usual. I don't like working with them.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Escort1.briefin: The target signature transmitted by the colnodes is marked on your map. Escort the commander to the specified location at %STATION_NAME%. Move from level to level until you are safe. Pirates are experienced boarders, so be careful. Exploring %STATION_NAME% is not included in the task list, but if you see something interesting, act according to the circumstances.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Escort1.details:
Details: %STATION_NAME% has long been in the hands of the Civil Resistance. The rebels organized one of their field headquarters here in order to systematically disturb all the enemies of the working people in this part of the Solar System. This does not suit both the corporations and the pirate crews.

The pirates placed a contract for the PMC to elminate the commander of %STATION_NAME%. We can take a contract from the CR to protect them. Not the most rewarding job, but a good way to improve relations with the rebels.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Escort1.objecti: Escort is a routine job. <color=#FFFEC1>Your task</color>: escort the colnode commander to the safe location specified by the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Espionage1.afte:
The Unchained Belt ordered the crew of %STATION_NAME% to change all operational plans. They suspect that the beneficiary is the Civil Resistance. If the pirates decide to take revenge, it will be possible to accept a contract from them as well.

The CR liaison took the PCPU and gave us the reward, it's already on the spacecraft.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Espionage1.brie: The sensors found a <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> clogged with data. However, the pirates at %STATION_NAME% have already been alerted. We'll try to get you as close to the target as possible. <color=#FFFEC1>Take the device and come back</color>. Only distract yourself with something else if the risk is worth it.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Espionage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the pirate <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Espionage1.deta: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> Lately, %STATION_NAME% has been the main center of operations for one extremely annoying pirate crew. Many raids organized from here were carried out against the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color>. The rebels would do well to know about the pirates' future plans. This can be arranged: we infiltrate %STATION_NAME%, find the <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> with pirate plans (sorry, not a treasure map), and the <color=#FFFEC1>CR</color> will be forced to exchange data for something useful to us.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Espionage1.obje: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Pick up the pirate <color=#FFFEC1>PCPU</color> from %STATION_NAME% and evacuate with it.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Infiltration1.a: The <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> is forced to look for another way to find out about the plans of the colnodes. We have already received our reward, but it seems that events around this station are only gaining momentum.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Infiltration1.b: It is necessary to prevent infiltration of %STATION_NAME% by destroying all groups of pirates. They are notorious for their excellent boarding teams. I believe in you, but be careful.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Infiltration1.d:
Details: Recently, %STATION_NAME% has been the main center of operations of the Civil Resistance against pirate crews. Colnodes learned that agents of the Unchained Belt had located this place and were preparing a spy operation. The pirates' target will be the PCPU with important data. If the device is stolen, the rebels will have to redo all operational and strategic plans.

If we want to receive a reward for this contract, we must eliminate all the pirate infiltration teams that will come for the PCPU.
The <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> frets and fumes. Pirates have lost an extremely convenient station for intercepting corporate spacecrafts. The colnodes have already delivered our reward to Magnum for the participation in the liberation of the working class.

10 seconds until landing. As soon as the pirates guarding %STATION_NAME% realize that the battle is lost, they will retreat or lay down their arms. It is enough to destroy 50% of the combatants.

Keep your eyes open! If you understand that you have enough strength and resources, you can explore this place. Apart from the capture, nothing else is included in the contract, that is, the customer will accept %STATION_NAME% in any condition. Colnodes don't get to choose.

Details: the Civil Resistance takes advantage of the chaos of the new redistribution of property. The rebels began sabotage, murder, and espionage against the enemies of the working people throughout the Solar System.

%STATION_NAME% is now the target of so-called "direct actions". That is, capture. This is where we come into the game.

Simple task: we go in, eliminate everyone capable of holding weapons, and leave until this place becomes another branch of hell. The colnodes will defend the station from counterattacks without us. The Unchained Belt has already sent all available pirate crews to protect %STATION_NAME%.

By the way, I almost forgot. Capturing a station always pays well. And trusting relationships with comrades from the Civil Resistance will not hurt us.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Robbery1.after: The pirate crew running %STATION_NAME% will have to deal with the destruction we caused there for a long time. The colnodes took the junk that we carried out for them. In return they gave us some equipment.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Robbery1.briefi: <color=#FFFEC1>Task</color>: find and pick up valuable items on each floor of the station. Smash and destroy everything you want, but take the goods. After that, evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Robbery1.detail:
For almost a hundred years, the Civil Resistance has been waging a desperate struggle against corporations. Humanity is enslaved. However, there are people who have left the ancap system and still show the highest degree of ignorance. Pirate crews are hindering the cause of the resistance. However, they can also be used in the fight against the enslavers of the working people.

We have at our disposal an information package, from which it follows that %STATION_NAME% contains valuable items. The rebels just lack them to intensify actions in this region of the Solar System. We can help them if we organize a movable property transaction.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Robbery1.object: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> On each floor of %STATION_NAME%, pick up valuable items, then evacuate.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Sabotage1.after: Great job, <color=#FFFEC1>Boss</color>. The colnodes prepared and sent valuable cargo to Magnum as a reward.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Sabotage1.brief: We have marked the locations of the <color=#FFFEC1>stockpiles</color> on your map. Do not expect to be dropped too close. The stockpiles are well hidden deep within %STATION_NAME%. We need to find and <color=#FFFEC1>destroy several piles of boxes</color>. You are allowed to deviate from the main task only if you find something truly important.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Sabotage1.desc: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Destroy the pirate resource warehouse on %STATION_NAME%.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Sabotage1.detai:
Details: Unfortunately, it's not just corporations that are oppressing the working class. Ignorant elements who do not understand the importance of self-organization and collective spirit are organizing criminal gangs and wasting human potential in vain.

Right now, at %STATION_NAME%, pirates have set up a resource warehouse. The liaison of the Civil Resistance invites us to destroy it so that some of the pirates will think: is the protection offered by the Unchained Belt worth it? If people have nothing to eat, perhaps they will join the rebels. There is even a recruitment point nearby.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Sabotage1.objec: You need to find and <color=#FFFEC1>destroy the pirate stockpiles</color>. A stockpile is a pile of crates. You have seen such piles many times in the cargo hold of the Magnum.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Security1.after: The colnodes will have to deal with the mess that the pirates created at %STATION_NAME% for a long time. We also took part in this, but received a reward.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Security1.brief: The %VICTIM_NAME% group has dispatched special squads to %STATION_NAME% to locate and seize critical equipment and data. You must <color=#FFFEC1>prevent these squads from leaving the station</color>. Comrades from the %BENEFICIARY_NAME% faction will consider it a failure if even one such squad manages to escape.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Security1.detai: Boss, pirate crews are attacking %STATION_NAME%, regardless of their losses. Looks like the <color=#FFFEC1>Unchained Belt</color> really needs something at this station. A group of defending comrades from the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> requests assistance. If we respond, we will need to provide the pirate teams with a decent greeting: hold back their attacks until reinforcements from the <color=#FFFEC1>CR</color> arrive.
mission.CivilRes_Pirates_Security1.objec: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Prevent the pirate squads from escaping %STATION_NAME%. I will mark them on your map.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Control1.after: It turns out that %VICTIM_NAME% is not omnipotent at all. Sooner or later, not only corporate, but also spiritual oppressors will be expelled from the Solar System.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Control1.briefing: The server location is marked on your map. The quasimorphs are already at %STATION_NAME%. Eliminate them all. The <color=#FFFEC1>equipment must survive</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Control1.details: <color=#FFFEC1>Details:</color> the <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> has seriously strengthened at %STATION_NAME%. Comrades carried out several successful operations from here against %VICTIM_NAME%. However, the monsters gathered for a counterattack. The rebels report that the target will be the station's server equipment. If we want to get a reward, we need to <color=#FFFEC1>prevent the quasimorphs from destroying the computer</color>.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Counterattack1.af: The <color=#FFFEC1>Civil Resistance</color> colnodes have already transferred the reward to Magnum. It seems that calm times will not come to the Solar System very soon. How many corporations and factions are there fighting for dominance and survival?
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Counterattack1.br: It will not be possible to drop you off close to the ritual site. At %STATION_NAME% there has been a real massacre for several days. We'll have to hurry. The quasimorphs must be stopped before the ritual is completed.
mission.CivilRes_Shedu_Counterattack1.de: <color=#FFFEC1>Task:</color> Eliminate the group of quasimorphs from %VICTIM_NAME% before the <color=#FFFEC1>ritual</color> is completed.
